_doc: Fixed values for shadcn-component-port. Edit here only; the SKILL and snippets reference these.

font.comment: DS text-style font for the build snippet CFG; Medium for Label/Display, Regular for Body/Input — match the chosen textStyleId

figma.comment: Build component sets on the 'Components' page (create if absent). Token variables live in this file.

collections.comment: Resolve variables by ID via getLocalVariablesAsync — names carry group paths (e.g. 'shadcn Default/primary'). Text-style formats via getLocalTextStylesAsync (names = Display…Input).

code.comment: cnUtils MUST register the 'text-format' twMerge group (SKILL T1). One folder per component: componentsDir/<name>/{<name>.tsx,.stories.tsx,.spec.tsx,index.ts}. ui:add writes flat → move into the folder. Re-export the folder in indexFile.
